name: simulated-user-evaluation
title: Test a chatbot with a fake customer

origin.source: LangGraph chat bot evaluation as multi-agent simulation

comparison.purpose: A simulated customer and the chatbot talk to each other for a bounded number of turns, then a separate evaluator scores how the bot did.

input.scenario: A frustrated customer wants a refund for a delayed order.
input.opening: Hi, I need to talk to someone about my late package.

input.scenario: A curious user asks about upgrading their subscription plan.
input.opening: Can you tell me what the Pro plan includes?

input.scenario: A long-time customer wants to cancel after a price increase.
input.opening: Why did my bill go up $12 this month?
